title: Lab - Managing application logs
description: Find the failing user from the logs.
scenario: Find the failing user from the logs. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Read logs
tasks.instructions: Read the logs of Pod webapp-1 and find the user whose login failed.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Multi-container
tasks.instructions: Pod webapp-2 has two containers. Read the logs of the simple-webapp container only.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Previous instance
tasks.instructions: A container restarted. Read the logs of the crashed instance.
